title: Private Italian & Mediterranean Home Cooking Class in Orlando
blurb: This experience stands out for its personal touch and focus on traditional, family recipes, giving you an authentic taste of Italian or Mediterranean cuisine in an inviting, private setting. Led by David in his spacious Orlando kitchen, you’ll prepare three delicious dishes from scratch, gaining hands-on experience and valuable cooking techniques. The class offers a fully customized menu based on the season and your dietary preferences, ensuring a unique and memorable meal. Conclude the experience by sharing the dishes you’ve crafted together, with a wine pairing for the perfect finishing touch.
